customs.question: How much does customs clearance cost?
customs.answer: It depends on fuel type, engine size, model year and the price of the car. The total is made up of import duty (10%), excise and VAT (20%). Excise is calculated from engine size and vehicle age. Our calculator or a manager will give you the exact figure.

turnkey.question: What is included in the turnkey price?
turnkey.answer: The lot price with the Copart or IAAI auction fee, delivery to the US port, ocean freight with insurance, forwarding, customs clearance with broker fees, car carrier to your city and our $200 fee. No charges beyond the agreed estimate.

damage.question: What if the car is damaged during shipping?
damage.answer: Every car is insured for the entire route. We photograph its condition at the US warehouse, at container loading and at handover. If damage occurs in transit, we file the insurance claim and cover the repair — you don't.

inspection.question: Can the car be inspected before purchase?
inspection.answer: Yes. Before bidding you receive a Carfax or AutoCheck report, the full auction photo set and our assessment of the damage. If needed, we send an expert to the lot for extra photos and video, plus an engine and body alignment check.

lostBid.question: What if we don't win the auction?
lostBid.answer: You lose nothing. The deposit carries over to the next lot in full or is refunded. We keep bidding on other options within the agreed budget until we buy your car.

delivery.question: How long does delivery take?
delivery.answer: On average 44 days from winning the bid to handover: 7–10 days for US inland logistics, 25–30 at sea to the port of Klaipeda, the rest for the car carrier and customs. The exact term depends on the state and the shipping line's load.

payments.question: What is the down payment and when is the rest due?
payments.answer: The bidding deposit starts at $500 and counts toward the price of the car. After winning, you pay the lot and the auction fee within 2 business days. Logistics and customs are paid before handover. Every amount is fixed in the contract before the first bid.

meta.title: About us — Revolution Auto: car import from the USA and Europe
meta.description: Revolution Auto is a team with 8+ years of experience importing cars from the USA, Europe, China and Korea. 600+ cars delivered turnkey: sourcing, bidding at Copart and IAAI, shipping and customs clearance. Based in Lviv, working across Ukraine.

intro.description: Revolution Auto is a Ukrainian company that brings cars from the USA, Europe, China and Korea turnkey. We went from being hired managers at other people's import companies to running our own team, one that walks each client from the first bid at Copart to the finished registration papers.

story.title: Our path: from managers at other companies to a team of our own

past.title: How it started
past.body1: In 2016 we started out as hired managers at companies importing cars from the USA. Hundreds of Copart and IAAI lots every day, Carfax reports, negotiations with brokers and container lines. That is where we learned to read auction photos, tell cosmetic damage from structural damage, and calculate customs clearance down to the last hryvnia.
past.body2: It is also where we saw the core problem of this market: clients were sold a car, not a result. Fees appeared only after the lot was won, delivery times from the USA kept slipping, and questions about the real state of the body got vague answers. We decided to build a service where every figure is known before the first bid.

present.title: Where we are now
present.body1: Since 2021 Revolution Auto has been our own team under one roof: sourcing and inspection, bidding at US auctions, ocean logistics, a customs broker and pre-sale preparation. Every area has a specific person accountable for it, so no client waits while a manager checks with the logistics guy.
present.body2: Today we import cars from the USA, Europe, China and Korea turnkey and have handed over more than 600 vehicles to their owners. The turnkey price is fixed in the contract before the first bid, every car is insured for the entire route, and clients get photo reports from the US warehouse, at container loading and before handover.

team.description: Every order is handled by a specific person, not an abstract department. Below is the Revolution Auto team: years in car import and the number of cars each manager has personally taken from the auction to handover.

start.title: Getting started
start.description: How we work and where to begin.

process.question: How does a turnkey car import work?
process.answer: It starts with a consultation about your budget, model and requirements. Then we sign a contract, shortlist lots and agree on every option with you. After the purchase we ship the car to Ukraine, clear customs, repair it if needed and help with registration. Each stage is described on the service pages, for example <usa>import from the USA</usa>.

country.question: Which country is best to import from?
country.answer: It depends on your budget, timeline and the type of car. The USA and Canada offer the widest choice and lower prices, but delivery takes longer. Europe and Norway are faster, and cars there more often come with a full service history. Korea and China stand out for newer cars and EVs. See the short <compare>country comparison</compare> further down this page.

contract.question: Do you work under a contract?
contract.answer: Always. Before the first bid we sign a contract that sets out our services, the cost and the payment schedule. Every payment after that is backed by an invoice.

budget.question: What budget should I plan for?
budget.answer: Plan around the full turnkey cost, not the lot price: logistics, duty, excise and VAT add a significant amount. You can get a preliminary figure for your option in the <calculator>calculator</calculator>, and a manager will help you pick a model that fits your budget.

cost.title: Cost and payments
cost.description: What the price is made of and when you pay.

turnkey.question: What does the turnkey price include?
turnkey.answer: The lot price, the auction fee, delivery to the port, ocean or truck shipping, customs clearance (duty, excise and VAT) and our services. Below you will find a line-by-line example, and for your own car use the <calculator>calculator</calculator>.

duties.question: How is customs clearance calculated?
duties.answer: Customs clearance consists of three payments. Import duty is 10% of the customs value, which is the car price plus delivery. Excise depends on fuel type, engine size and the age of the car, or on battery capacity for EVs. VAT of 20% is charged on the customs value, duty and excise combined.

payments.question: What do I pay and when?
payments.answer: Payments are made in stages. After signing the contract you pay for our search and selection service. After winning the auction you pay for the lot and the auction fee. Logistics and customs are paid at their respective stages. All amounts are known upfront and fixed in the contract.

extra.question: Can there be extra charges?
extra.answer: No, unless the terms you agreed to change. We fix the estimate before bidding. Additional costs are only possible by your decision, for example repairs after arrival, and are always agreed with you separately.

fee.question: How much do your services cost?
fee.answer: Our fee is fixed and already included in the <calculator>calculator</calculator> estimate. A manager will confirm the exact amount for your case during the consultation and put it in the contract.

auction.title: Auctions and choosing a car
auction.description: How we pick lots and what to know about bidding.

inspection.question: Can I check the car before bidding?
inspection.answer: Yes. Before the bid you get a history report (Carfax or AutoCheck for North American cars), the auction photos and our assessment of the damage and estimated repairs. For Korea and Europe we check inspection reports and service history.

damage.question: Is it worth buying a car after an accident?
damage.answer: Often, yes: most lots at US auctions have some damage, and that is exactly where the discount comes from. The key is telling cosmetic damage from structural issues such as a bent frame, deployed airbags or flood traces. We estimate repairs before bidding so the final price stays worthwhile.

titles.question: What do Clean, Salvage and Rebuilt titles mean?
titles.answer: A title is the ownership document for a car in the USA. Clean means the insurer never declared the car a total loss. Salvage is issued when repairs were deemed uneconomical, and these cars are the cheapest. Rebuilt is given to cars restored after a salvage title. All three can be cleared through customs and registered in Ukraine; the difference is in price and condition.

lostBid.question: What happens if I am outbid?
lostBid.answer: Nothing to worry about. We never go above the agreed limit and keep bidding on other approved lots. The selection service covers the whole search, not a single bid.

ownLot.question: Can I find a lot myself?
ownLot.answer: Yes. Send the link to a manager: we will check the history and damage, calculate the full turnkey cost and tell you whether it is worth bidding on. You can also browse cars already on their way or in stock in our <catalog>catalog</catalog>.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Timelines, routes and keeping the car safe on the way.

term.question: How long does delivery take?
term.answer: It depends on the country: 7-14 days from Europe, 10-20 from Norway, 40-50 from the USA, 45-60 from Korea and China, 50-70 from Canada. We count from purchase to arrival in Ukraine. All routes are side by side in the <compare>comparison below</compare>.

insurance.question: What if the car is damaged during delivery?
insurance.answer: The car is insured during transport. We photograph its condition at every stage: at the yard, at loading and at handover. If damage happens on the way, we file an insurance claim.

tracking.question: How do I know where my car is right now?
tracking.answer: A manager updates you at every stage: purchase, arrival at the port, departure, arrival in Europe and at customs. For ocean shipping we share the container number so you can track it yourself.

destination.question: Where do you deliver the car?
destination.answer: After customs clearance we deliver the car by truck to your city, or you can pick it up in Lviv. The option and the cost of delivery within Ukraine are agreed in advance.

customs.title: Customs and registration
customs.description: What happens to the car after it arrives in Ukraine.

electric.question: How are electric cars cleared through customs?
electric.answer: For EVs the excise is based on battery capacity: 1 euro per kWh. Duty and VAT are charged the same way as for other cars. The <calculator>calculator</calculator> shows the exact amount for a specific model.

certification.question: Why is certification needed?
certification.answer: A car cannot be registered in Ukraine without a certificate of conformity. It confirms that the car meets technical and environmental requirements. We help you get certified right after customs clearance.

registration.question: Who registers the car?
registration.answer: Registration takes place at a Ministry of Internal Affairs service center in your name. We prepare the document package and walk you through the steps, so one visit is usually enough.

documents.question: Which documents will I receive?
documents.answer: The contract with us, the purchase documents (the auction or seller invoice and the ownership document), export and customs documents, and the certificate of conformity. That is everything you need for registration.

risks.title: Guarantees and risks
risks.description: An honest look at what can go wrong and how we prevent it.

condition.question: What if the car is in worse condition than in the photos?
condition.answer: Auctions sell cars as is, so the main protection is a thorough check before bidding: history reports, photo analysis and, if needed, an on-site inspection. If something cannot be seen in the photos, we warn you and build a margin into the repair estimate.

money.question: How is my money protected?
money.answer: All terms are fixed in the contract, and every payment is backed by an invoice or receipt. You pay in stages and only for clearly defined items. You can read our clients' stories in the <reviews>reviews</reviews>.

refuse.question: Can I back out after winning the auction?
refuse.answer: A bid at auction is a commitment to buy, so backing out after winning means a penalty from the auction. That is why we agree on every lot and bid limit with you in advance.

sell.title: Selling a car
sell.description: If you want to sell a car rather than buy one.

options.question: How can I sell my car through you?
options.answer: There are two options. <buyout>Buyout</buyout>: we assess the car at inspection and pay on the day of the deal. <consignment>Sale from our lot</consignment>: the car stays at our parking, we find a buyer at market price, and the service is free for you.

sellDocuments.question: Which documents do I need to sell?
sellDocuments.answer: The vehicle registration certificate, the owner's passport and tax ID. If the seller is not the owner, a power of attorney is required.

credit.question: Can I sell a car that is still on credit?
credit.answer: In most cases, yes. We help pay off the loan from the buyout amount and remove the encumbrance. A manager will clarify the details.

hero.title: We will buy your car in 1 day

fairPrice.title: Price on the spot
fairPrice.description: We appraise the car in front of you and name the price right away, with no phone promises that change later.

anyCondition.title: Any condition
anyCondition.description: We buy cars after accidents, with technical faults or high mileage.

instantPayment.title: Money right away
instantPayment.description: Payment on the day of the deal, with no waiting for buyers or haggling.

documents.title: We handle the paperwork

request.title: Request

inspection.title: Inspection at our lot
inspection.description: We agree on a time, you bring the car to our lot, and our appraiser inspects it.

offer.title: Appraisal and offer
offer.description: We inspect the car, check the documents and name the buyout price right away.

deal.title: Contract and payment
deal.description: We sign the contract and pay the same day in the way that suits you.

cars.question: What cars do you buy?
cars.answer: Cars, crossovers and pickups of any year, including after accidents or with faults. The final decision comes after inspection.

price.question: How is the buyout price set?
price.answer: We assess condition, trim, mileage and current market prices for similar models. You get the price right after inspection.

documents.question: What documents are needed?
documents.answer: The registration certificate, passport and tax ID of the owner. If someone else sells the car, a power of attorney is required.

credit.question: Can I sell a car that is still on credit?
credit.answer: In most cases, yes. We help close the loan from the buyout amount and remove the lien. A manager will clarify the details.

meta.description: We sell your car at market price: our lot, professional photos, listings on major platforms and in our catalog. Free for the seller.

hero.title: We will sell your car at market price
hero.lede: Leave the car at our lot and we do the rest: photos, listings, buyers, negotiations and the deal. Free for you.

free.title: Free for you
free.description: The buyer pays the sales commission. You receive the agreed price in full.

parking.title: The car stays at our lot
parking.description: No need to show the car to strangers or fit your schedule around buyers.

listing.title: Photos and listings
listing.description: Professional photos and strong listings on major platforms. We handle negotiations.

catalog.title: Your car in our catalog
catalog.description: Your car appears in the Cars in stock section of our website, where our clients see it.

request.title: Request
request.description: Leave your contacts, and we clarify the car and your price expectations.

inspection.title: Inspection and price
inspection.description: We inspect the car, analyse the market and agree on the selling price together.

listing.title: Lot and listings
listing.description: The car stays at our lot. We take photos and list it on platforms and in our catalog.

buyers.title: Buyers and negotiations
buyers.description: We show the car to buyers, answer questions and negotiate.

deal.title: Deal
deal.description: We close the deal and you receive the agreed amount.

commission.question: How much does selling cost me?
commission.answer: Nothing: the buyer pays the commission. A manager will tell you its amount before you sign the contract.

parking.question: Where is the car kept during the sale?
parking.answer: At our lot. This way we can show it to buyers at any time without bothering you.

term.question: How long does it take to sell?
term.answer: It depends on the model, condition and price. A car at market price usually finds a buyer within a few weeks.

usage.question: Can I use the car while it is for sale?
usage.answer: During the sale the car stays at our lot so we can show it to buyers quickly. If you urgently need it, we will work something out.
